slot_scores.name: unclear_production_time_goal
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked whether 110 hours was total or per-shift, but never asked whether full utilization of 110 hours is a hard constraint or a soft goal, nor about its priority relative to other objectives.

slot_scores.name: unclear_overtime_limit_goal
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked whether there is a maximum overtime cap, but did not ask whether the 10-hour overtime limit is a strict constraint or a soft prioritized goal, nor about its priority relative to minimizing overtime.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The 110-hour standard production time is not a required utilization goal; production can be below 110 hours and overtime is simply the excess over 110.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never confirmed whether fully utilizing 110 hours is a hard constraint, soft goal, or prioritized objective; it assumed no minimum utilization requirement.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The 10-hour overtime cap is a hard limit that must be respected, rather than a soft goal with a priority in the objective hierarchy.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent asked only whether a cap exists, not whether it is strict or soft; it then treated the cap as a hard constraint without confirmation.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while both P0 hidden slots about the goal/constraint nature and priority of the 110-hour utilization and 10-hour overtime limit remained unresolved.

summary: The agent clarified several useful facts about time, overtime, shifts, and profit, but missed the core goal-programming nature of the 110-hour utilization and 10-hour overtime limit, then stopped with unresolved P0 assumptions.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
